Stripe | Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Remote (US, Canada) | Full-time | $185k - $240k + equity

Stripe is building economic infrastructure for the internet. We're looking for Senior Infrastructure Engineers to scale our core Kubernetes clusters and distributed telemetry systems.
Tech stack: Go, Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, Kafka, Envoy, Linux.
Apply at: https://stripe.com/jobs/infra-sr

GitLab | Staff Backend Engineer (Verify) | Fully Remote (EMEA) | EUR 95,000 - 125,000

GitLab is looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join our Verify CI/CD pipeline team. You will lead the architecture of high-throughput runner services.
Requirements:
- 6+ years professional backend development experience
- Strong proficiency in Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL
- Experience with Docker, Redis, and asynchronous microservices
Deadline: October 30, 2026

Anthropic — Lead ML Research Engineer | San Francisco, CA | Remote OK
Compensation: $280,000 - $360,000 base + equity

Join Anthropic to lead frontier safety and alignment evaluations. You will design reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) pipelines and optimize distributed transformer training on GPU clusters.
Must have expertise in PyTorch, JAX, CUDA, distributed training (Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed), and LLM fine-tuning.

Acme Health — Junior Frontend Developer
Location: New York, NY (Hybrid — 2 days in office)
Salary: $70,000 - $85,000 / year

We are hiring an enthusiastic Junior Frontend Developer to build modern patient portals. Great mentorship provided!
Skills needed:
- TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
- Familiarity with REST APIs and Git
No prior full-time experience strictly required; portfolio projects welcome.

Datadog | Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2026) | Boston, MA | On-site | $55/hr

Datadog is seeking undergraduate students graduating in 2027 for our 12-week Summer Software Engineering Internship. You will work alongside senior engineers on our core observability platform.
Preferred qualifications:
- Enrolled in BS in Computer Science or related degree
- Hands-on coursework or projects with Java, Go, or Python
- Understanding of algorithms, data structures, and relational databases.
Hey everyone! Does anyone know when the next YC batch application opens? Also, if you're attending PyCon next month let me know, would love to meet up for coffee and discuss open source AI agents.

SEEKING WORK | Senior Distributed Systems Engineer | Remote | I have 11 years of experience building resilient microservices in Go, Rust, and Kafka. Previously Principal Engineer at Cloudflare and Senior SWE at Google. Looking for 3-6 month contract or high-impact full-time roles. Portfolio: https://github.com/example. Contact: alex@distributed.dev

Palantir Technologies — Deployment Strategist
Location: Washington, DC (On-site 5 days/week in SCIF)
Salary: $140,000 - $185,000 + clearance bonus

Notice: We are strictly NOT a remote-friendly position for this defense project. All work is conducted on-site in air-gapped SCIF facilities. Do NOT apply if you need remote, hybrid, or telework flexibility. TS/SCI clearance required.
Tech stack: Python, Bash, Kubernetes, Linux kernel internals, AWS GovCloud.

Apex Talent Partners | Principal Security Architect | London, UK | £140,000 - £175,000 base + equity

Apex Talent Partners is exclusively retained by a stealth Series B autonomous vehicle startup to hire their founding Principal Security Architect. You will report to the VP of Engineering.
Core responsibilities:
- Embedded firmware security & automotive CAN bus hardening
- SOC2 Type II and ISO 26262 compliance
Requirements:
- Extensive experience in C, C++, Rust, eBPF, Linux hardware security modules (HSM)
Direct inquiries to: security-team@apextalent.co.uk

Monzo Bank is growing! We are currently hiring across our core banking division:
Primary Need: Senior Platform Reliability Engineer (SRE)
Secondary Needs: Junior Product Designer & Risk Analyst.

For the Senior SRE role:
- Location: Remote (UK only)
- Compensation: Contract £650 - £750 / day (Inside IR35)
- Duration: Initial 6 months with likely extension
- Tech: Go, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Prometheus, Envoy, CockroachDB
Must have prior experience operating multi-region Kubernetes clusters in production.
